item.title: New bridge planned for Shippagan
item.description: The provincial government announced on Thursday it is starting preparations on a new bridge between Lamèque Island and Shippagan. The province said in a news release that $1.5 million is being set aside for the design and planning of a new bridge on Rte. 113. “Starting work on a new bridge connecting Île-de-Lamèque and Shippagan […]
